title: Godly Skincare
body: Dan is scrolling through BikBok one day and discovers the importance of skincare. He starts using products he found online and keeps track of these products in a DataFrame called dan\_products. The columns are as follows: Product is the name of the product (type $$=$$ str). Brand is the brand the product is from (type $$=$$ str). Aura is the effectiveness of a product according to Dan (type $$=$$ numpy.int64). Price is the price of a product in USD on Berkazon (type $$=$$ numpy.float64). Stars is the online rating of the product on Berkazon (type $$=$$ numpy.float64). Repurchased indicates whether or not Dan has repurchased the product (type $$=$$ numpy.bool\_).\n##figure1.gif
